definitions.explanation: The most common verb for verbal expression. Used when someone speaks words or expresses something verbally. Unlike {話|はな}す (hanasu) which emphasizes conversation or storytelling, {言|い}う focuses on the act of uttering specific words or statements.

examples.english: He said, 'I don't want to go.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}って⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}いました。
examples.english: The teacher said there will be a test tomorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{起|お}き→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦なさい→なさい：09856_nasai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{言|い}います⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{起|お}きたくない→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{思|おも}っています→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: My mother says 'Get up early!' every morning, but I always think I don't want to get up.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: 「〜」と{言|い}う (say '~') or Xを{言|い}う (say X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing or repeated action. {言|い}っている = 'is saying' or 'has been saying.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・「〜」と{言|い}う (say '~' - quotation)
・〜と{言|い}われている (it is said that ~)
・{言|い}い{方|かた} (way of saying)
・と{言|い}えば (speaking of)

Compare: {話|はな}す emphasizes conversation/storytelling, while {言|い}う focuses on the specific words uttered.
